deep_analysis:
One position, one problem. Trade #17038 BTC LONG (opened 20:03:07Z, entry 60,351, meta_rsi 44.6 at signal, confidence 49.5) is -0.31% at 2.6h against a tape that turned against it 2h after entry: 1m crossed below continuum EMA300 at 22:05:58Z after ~25h above and has now held below for 74 consecutive minutes (price 60,171 vs EMA300 60,289, zscore -2.45 STRONG_NEG, trend_quality STRONG_DOWN, velocity SLOW, acceleration NEGATIVE, volume LOW). The trade's premise (continuum-osc+ long) was valid at entry and has degraded since — but we are NOT issuing an urgent exit on the "below EMA300" condition alone: brain_auditor #139 measured that cell (LONG, meta_rsi 45-64, BELOW EMA300) as the PROFITABLE one (+0.03 7d / +1.42 30d) with the bleed sitting AT/ABOVE, and measurement refutation outranks condition persistence. The honest read is that this is a CHOP tape (auto_trader regime CHOP/MANAGE_ONLY, volume LOW, only 2 coins with ATR>0.5% in the last hour among fresh tokens) and the trade has never reached +0.40% MFE — it is exactly the profile that feeds the never-arm cohort (52/56 hard_max_loss trades never armed). Geometry is fine (SL 59,977 = -0.62%, TP 61,558 = +2.0%, ~1:3.2), so the decision is: hold only while momentum stops making new lows; exit early on continuation rather than donate a full stop to chop. Do not add, do not average.

Wrong-side accounting for the open trade: the winning side right now is SHORT — 69 of 127 tokens are 5m SHORT_BIAS vs 3 long, btc_15m SHORT_BIAS, BTC 1m below EMA300 with LEAN_BEAR linreg, and auto_trader scores short +15. Our single slot is on the opposite side. Counterweight (stated, not hidden): btc_4h is still LONG_BIAS, wyckoff ACCUMULATION / market_phase RECOVERY, 1h linreg slope still +0.099, and the regime flip-rate is NORMAL (aggregate 20 flips/24h, BTC 23 — p50-p75 of the 19-dump distribution, not the >=26 p95 anomaly), so snapshot direction churns about hourly and a single 74-minute below-EMA300 stretch is not a confirmed trend tape. Mixed sources = advisory severity, not urgent.

24h book is actually fine: 30 closes, 56.7% WR, +$0.75. The bleed is specific, not systemic — every 24h LONG loser fired at meta_rsi >= 48 (BLUR 71.4/70.6/72.7/64.3, ETC 60.0, APT 59.7) on pumps that stalled just below trail arm (prearm_lock with MFE 0.31-0.58), while winners were dip LONGs (WCT 44.8, SOL 49.5) and the HYPE SHORT. Repeated BLUR longs at RSI 64-73 losing four times in 24h is the clearest single finding of the cycle: the winning side was SHORT BLUR, and BLUR is now the steepest confirmed 5m downtrend in the scanner (conf 90.9, r2 0.81, slope -0.111). We are taking that side as this hour's watchlist pick.

Portfolio: 1 of 6 slots used, 0 shorts, all exposure is one counter-tape BTC long — no correlation cluster, no stale trades (2.6h), no 2%+/5%+/8h+ enforcement triggers this cycle (none met), and no capital tied up in losers. Opportunity cost is low; in_market 58% over 24h with +$0.75 realized.

Pattern status: pump-chain+ is NOT a dead signal (7d traffic 7T, 0W, -0.23 — enabled and emitting, so flagged live, not stale-window) and its recent losses are all high-RSI longs that never armed. ai-trader-pending remains the weakest family (7d 21T/6W/28.6%/-0.14) and bleeds at BOTH RSI extremes — this cycle re-tested and unchanged (only 1 close since the prior cycle, HYPE +0.07), so the ARM-time RSI band recommendation stands at age=7 cycles unexecuted. Chop-bleed KPI is inside normal band: 7d 79.3% dollar share (46 of 58 losers never armed, gross -$4.87, NULL mfe=0, same-day arm 70.0% on 30 closes) — neither the >=92% entry-quality breach nor the <=70% exit-ownership breach, so ownership stays with entry quality, not trail distance.
